name: Surface
description:
A piece of glass. Picks a material from glass.css and a radius role; layout is the
caller's. Prefer Panel for content panes — it adds the header/body/footer slots.
signature: <T extends ElementType = "div">({ as, material, radius, padding, container, className, ...rest }: SurfaceProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: as
props.description: Semantic element rendered by the polymorphic component.

props.name: container
props.description: Make this surface a size container so its contents can respond with

props.name: material
props.description: Shared glass material. Use card for repeated tiles: the panel rim and fill without backdrop blur.

props.name: padding
props.description: Semantic padding role. `overlay` is the item-list inset; pair it with `radius="overlay"` so `.fa-item` rows nest.
